CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget; banks forecast record house price declines, signalling a housing correction underway
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle offering a small-cap bright spot
ASIC launches whistleblower review of Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns across ASX-listed entities
EV sales overtake petrol cars in Australia for first time, reshaping consumer and energy transition dynamics
Global money funds see largest inflow in a month as investors rotate to caution; bond markets delivering a 'reality check'
Bathla construction collapse flagged as symptomatic of broader Australian 'Ponzi economy' fragility in property and infrastructure

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical distraction; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength; Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from structural demand shift; small-cap gold and critical minerals (AUR.AX, VDL.AX) offer diversification; iron ore price volatility elevated

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price falls; ASIC whistleblower review of accounting giants; CBA/Westpac loyalty-fee loophole exposed
sectors.implications: NIM pressure and credit-loss provisions likely to rise for CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX; housing downturn threatens mortgage revenue; governance scrutiny may pressure audit-firm-linked equities

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; energy transition costs mounting; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns; Qantas engine incident highlights operational risk
sectors.implications: Gas producers (WDS.AX, GWO.AX, TMK) benefit from rate spikes; transition-cost overhang weighs on utilities; LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) see mixed signals

sectors.trend: EV sales surpass petrol cars for first time driven by fuel-cost avoidance; hidden EV ownership costs emerging; construction sector fragility (Bathla) signals broader consumer confidence erosion
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from EV shift; auto-related supply chains disrupted; construction names (WBC.AX exposure, GPT.AX) face demand softening

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, tablet alternatives emerging; Australia faces acute AI-worker and tradie shortage; Nvidia AI boom narrative continues
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma retail) may see GLP-1 tablet shift; tech/AI talent scarcity supports SSG.AX, W1.AX; global AI capex cycle (NVDA) supports sentiment

key_themes: RBA rate path uncertainty: market pricing hikes but economy stalling, creating a policy dilemma
Housing correction: record price falls forecast, 15% loan application drop, construction sector fragility
Commodity structural shift: iron ore shakeout, gas rate volatility, EV transition accelerating
Governance and regulatory scrutiny: ASIC whistleblower review, bank fee practices, Victoria debt warnings
Global risk-off rotation: money fund inflows, bond reality check, gold bullion relocation to London
Australian economic stagnation vs Canada's per-capita growth divergence

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike amid stalling economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour rate-sensitive defensives (WES.AX, WTW.AX) and avoid high-beta growth; hedge with ^AXJO short exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce bank exposure (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX); avoid REITs with high residential exposure (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX); favour commercial/industrial REITs
Diversify away from pure iron ore (RIO.AX, FMG.AX) toward gold (AUR.AX, NGT.AX) and critical minerals; monitor China stimulus signals
Avoid speculative construction and property developers; favour cash-generative industrials; monitor Bathla-type cascading failures
Maintain liquidity; consider AUD-hedged positions; monitor gold bullion flows and money fund inflows as leading indicators

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC regulatory action on accounting firms
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review corporate governance of holdings; favour companies with independent audit tracks; monitor for ASX-listed entities using affected firms

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-minerals small caps as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore shakeout and global de-dollarisation (gold bullion to London) support gold; critical minerals benefit from energy transition

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas-exposed energy names ahead of rate surge
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rates spiking; Beetaloo cartel dynamics create pricing upside for gas producers

opportunities.recommendation: Position in consumer defensives ahead of rate decision
opportunities.rationale: Rate-hike fears and housing stress favour staples; EV shift supports WES/WTW long-term but near-term margin pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap bank and iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 15% loan application drop, record house price fall forecasts, and iron ore shakeout create downside risk to CBA, BHP, RIO, FMG

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid residential REITs and construction-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing construction following prices lower; Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; Melbourne councils cannot cope with growth
Global money fund inflows and bond 'reality check' signal caution; liquidity premium warranted amid policy uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as RBA rate-hike expectations dominate. Housing data (15% loan drop, record price fall forecasts) will weigh on financials and REITs. Iron ore volatility and global risk-off flows cap upside. Small-cap miners and gas names offer relative outperformance. Expect 2–4% index volatility into RBA decision.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction, iron ore demand shift, and energy transition costs suggest a grinding, lower-beta market. Gold, critical minerals, and gas offer thematic tailwinds. AI/tech talent scarcity supports select ASX tech names. Australia's per-capita stagnation vs Canada is a medium-term concern for equity risk premia. 'Bull case returns' narrative (macrobusiness) may gain traction if RBA pauses.
